$comment: schema_version 0.1.0; validates replay_result.yaml written by nova replay.
title: ReplayResult
description: Output manifest of a NovaFabric replay run. Written to .novafabric/replays/<replay-id>/replay_result.yaml.

replay_id.description: ULID uniquely identifying this replay run.

replay_of_run_id.description: run_id of the source capsule being replayed.

start_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the replay started.

end_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the replay finished.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the replay in milliseconds.

policy_flags_used.description: Safety ladder flags active during this replay.

env_warnings.description: Environment differences between recorded env.lock and current runtime.

model_calls_mocked.description: Number of model calls served from cache. In mocked mode (ADR-0300) this is the number of recorded responses the dispatcher actually served, counted from its event log.

tool_calls_mocked.description: Number of tool responses served from the capsule. ADR-0300: only mocked mode installs a tool dispatcher, and only on mcp.ClientSession.call_tool; every other mode reports 0 (ADR-0261).

tool_calls_available.description: Recorded tool calls on a surface a tool dispatcher can serve (MCP tools/call, ADR-0300). Additive and optional (ADR-0261); not a claim that any were substituted. See tool_calls_recorded for every recorded call.

tool_calls_recorded.description: Every tool call the capsule recorded, whatever its surface. Additive and optional (ADR-0300).

model_calls_available.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): recorded model responses the dispatcher can serve (supported provider surface, successful call, a recorded choice). Additive and optional.

model_calls_unmatched.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): model calls the replay made that had no recorded response to serve (queue exhausted, provider/order mismatch, malformed record, or a refused unsupported surface). Additive and optional.

tool_calls_live.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): calls on the intercepted tool surface that executed live (only possible with --permissive). Calls on surfaces replay does not intercept are not observed and not counted here. Additive and optional.

tool_calls_unmatched.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): calls on the intercepted tool surface with no unconsumed recorded result. Additive and optional.

queues_fully_consumed.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): every servable recorded model response and MCP tool result was consumed. Additive and optional.

divergence_reason.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): the first divergence from the recorded run, with a count of any others. Absent when the replay followed the recording. Additive and optional.

replay_contract.description: Mocked mode (ADR-0300): divergence policy, intercepted surfaces, recorded/live/unconsumed counts and the list of divergences. Additive and optional. ADR-0304 adds the observed live network connections.

network_observed.description: ADR-0304: the replayed process reported its outbound connections (socket connect observer installed).

network_connections_live.description: ADR-0304: IPv4/IPv6 connection attempts the replayed Python process made (observed, never blocked). A lower bound when network_connections_capped is true.

network_connections_capped.description: ADR-0304: more connections were made than the observer logs per process.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the replayed command (mocked mode only).

error.description: Error details if status is failure or aborted.

schema_drift.description: Tool calls whose stored arguments/result no longer conform to their declared *_schema_ref (ADR-0128). Additive, optional; recorded in every mode, gating only in exact.
